name: Miner's Fortune
summary: Wharfmaster Dizzywig has heard of a fist-sized emerald at the Venture Company's Boulder Lode Mine. He hires you to take the Cats Eye Emerald from the mine's supervisors and share the profits.

sections.title: Eyes on the Docks
sections.body: Wharfmaster Dizzywig hears the merchants who pass through Ratchet's harbor on the routes between Ratchet and Booty Bay. Word reaches him of a huge gem found deep in the Boulder Lode Mine. The Venture Company strips the northern Barrens for its own gain, so few are likely to ask questions if its finest recent find disappears.

sections.title: A Cut of the Lode
sections.body: Northeast of the Sludge Fen, laborers fill the Boulder Lode Mine's rocky shaft. The Venture Co. Overseers and Enforcers have taken the Cats Eye Emerald, and an ordinary digger cannot claim a prize so rare. You need to face the armed managers, secure the stone, and bring it to Dizzywig. He can judge its value against the market in Undermine.

faq.answer: Wharfmaster Dizzywig is a goblin dock official in Ratchet. He oversees cargo and passengers traveling by sea to and from Booty Bay, and trades in gossip, rumors, and merchant information.

faq.q: Where is the Boulder Lode Mine located?
faq.answer: The Boulder Lode Mine lies in the northern Barrens, in the hills just northeast of the Sludge Fen's oil operation.

faq.q: Who holds the Cats Eye Emerald at the mine?
faq.answer: The Venture Co. Overseers and Venture Co. Enforcers hold the Cats Eye Emerald. They direct and guard the mining work at the Boulder Lode Mine.

faq.q: What is the Venture Company's interest in the Barrens?
aliases: why is venture co in barrens
faq.answer: The Venture Company is a goblin trade syndicate that rapidly exploits resources. In the northern Barrens, it drills at the Sludge Fen and digs at Boulder Lode Mine for timber, oil, and minerals, with little regard for local ecology.
Undermine is the goblin cartels' underground island city and ancestral capital. Its markets set prices for precious gems and rare goods across Azeroth.

faq.q: Does Dizzywig actually share the profits?
faq.answer: Dizzywig promises you half the estimated Undermine market value when you deliver the Cats Eye Emerald, and he honors the bargain.

angles.text: As a miner, you can recognize how rare a whole emerald the size of a fist is. Gems of that size almost never survive excavation without cracking or breaking.
As a rogue, you know how to slip into a hostile camp and take a guarded gemstone from greedy overseers.
As a Horde member, you strike at the Venture Company's managers at Boulder Lode Mine and disrupt an industrial cartel encroaching on Horde-held Barrens lands.
